prompt: Generate a square reproduction of a harbor scene painted in a restrained plein-air manner. In the foreground, show muddy shore and wooden structures, including a prominent slanted ladder or gangway rising near the center-left. Several sailing vessels and masts occupy the middle ground, the largest dark ship moored just right of center. To the left are low industrial or dockside buildings and a hint of smoke. Calm pale water extends to the right with smaller boats in the distance under a cloudy gray-cream sky. Use muted greens, tans, grays, and soft blues, brisk naturalistic brushwork, and the slightly dry, timeworn surface of an older oil painting.
